security_spec.violation_condition: In QEMU TCG's PMP/SPMP access check path (target/riscv/pmp.c), when a guest memory access targets a shadow-stack PMP region (pmpcfg.E=1 with XWR=010 or XWR=110), QEMU fails to enforce the new per-privilege-mode and per-instruction-type access restrictions: (a) allowing non-shadow-stack store instructions to write to shadow-stack regions, (b) allowing shadow-stack instructions to access non-shadow-stack regions, (c) allowing implicit accesses (instruction fetch, page table walk) to shadow-stack regions, (d) allowing lower-privilege-mode accesses to higher-privilege-mode shadow-stack regions, or (e) failing to fault when pmpcfg.E=1 with a reserved XWR encoding is matched.
security_spec.summary: New shadow-stack PMP region types (E=1/XWR=010 for M-mode, E=1/XWR=110 for U-mode, SPMP XWR=010) introduce privilege-mode-gated store/load/fetch access rules that QEMU TCG must enforce in its PMP check fast-path; missing enforcement allows guest M/U/S-mode shadow-stack bypass, breaking backward-edge CFI and enabling ROP-style guest-to-guest privilege escalation
